subject: Weekly exec staff bulletin — Wins / Risks / Asks (QBR prep)
messages:
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 19 Feb 2026 08:42:00 -0800
Subject: Weekly exec staff bulletin — Wins / Risks / Asks (QBR prep)

Good morning team — sending the weekly exec staff bulletin as we lock in QBR materials. Short summary (action items at the bottom). Attached: QBR deck draft + current OKR snapshot.

Wins:
- Hosted API latency improvements: 12% median p95 reduction after kernel tuning (release 2026-02-17). Ops reported stable telemetry.
- New Dedicated pilot: signed PO with AsterGrid (mid-market) — expected $120k ARR starting next month.

Risks / Concerns:
- GPU capacity constraints in us-west region are beginning to show for dedicated-backed workloads; some internal runs had retry rates spike ~1.8% on Tuesday. We need mitigation options (overflow routing / temporary burst nodes).
- QBR narrative: we still need a crisp cost-per-query story for customers who care about unit economics; current slides feel too high-level.

Asks / Decisions needed:
1) Markus: can you propose a short-term runbook for capacity spikes (options: soft throttle + fallback to quantized model, or temporary dedicated burst pool)? Need recommendation by EOD Friday.
2) Vivek & Monica: please confirm top 3 accounts to highlight in the QBR (customer wins / testimonials). If we want Samantha at ACME to appear in the slides, confirm permission and quote by Monday.
3) Evelyn: request a one-slide summary on roadmap risks for next quarter (1–2 bullets).

Meeting: I'm scheduling a 30-min QBR dry run on Monday 2/23 at 10:00am PT — invite to follow.

Attachments:
- QBR-Deck-v1.pdf (attached)
- OKR-Snapshot-2026Q1.xlsx (attached)

Thanks — Laura

--
Laura Bennett
Head of Strategy, Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.ai

From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>

Date: Thu, 19 Feb 2026 10:10:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Weekly exec staff bulletin — Wins / Risks / Asks (QBR prep)

Laura — quick technical follow-up.

We saw the retry/latency blips and traced them to an NVLink topology mismatch on a small subset of nodes after the kernel roll-forward. Short-term mitigation options (ranked):
1) Immediate: enable fallback routing for dedicated workloads to the quantized v2 model (adds ~8% quality delta but cuts memory pressure). Can be done in hours and minimizes 5xx spike.
2) Medium: provision 4 burst GPUs in us-west (reserved) for the next 2 weeks — requires procurement approval but eliminates the immediate pressure.
3) Long-term: scheduler change to prefer cross-rack allocation for heavy KV workloads — engineering effort (2-3 sprints).

Recommend we do option 1 this afternoon and open procurement ticket for option 2 as backup. I will draft the runbook and post to the drive.
